parent_objective: audit M2128 localization result before candidate qualification or comparison interpretation
blocked_by: M2128 localization must complete before result audit
supersedes: direct controller ranking from comparison-ready candidate rows
direct paper claim from generated comparison-support smoke proxies

public_gates: M2129 must audit M2128 localization completeness and guardrails
M2129 must decide whether candidate qualification is admitted
M2129 must not rerun localization reset rollout or execute policy actions
M2129 must keep ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat comparison-support smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits localized support and decides whether bounded candidate qualification is admitted
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: localization result audit only; no controller ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2128 localization is incomplete
stop if outcome counts do not reproduce source summary
stop if no support candidates exist and same-panel repair is proposed without synthesis
stop if audit ranks profiles directly
fallback_plan: route to candidate qualification design if support candidates are sufficient
route to scenario repair or synthesis if support is insufficient
route to schema repair if localization artifacts are invalid
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2128 localization completes and requires result audit

allowed_updates: M2129 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for candidate qualification design scenario repair or synthesis
next_stage_criteria: candidate counts and dominance counts are summarized
supported and unsupported claims are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2129 audits localization output and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2129.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If support candidates are not sufficient, record the negative result and route to redesign or synthesis rather than ranking aggregates.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns localized support evidence into a bounded next-route decision before comparison
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit candidate qualification but cannot make a paper verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2129 routes to repeated local repair despite sufficient support candidates

hypothesis: M2128 localization found enough comparison-ready/support candidates to admit bounded candidate qualification, but not direct ranking or paper claims.
success_criteria: candidate and dominance counts are summarized
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new reset or rollout is performed
ranking or paper-level claims are made

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write docs/m2129-paper-route-outcome-supported-decisive-comparison-support-outcome-localization-result-audit.md from M2128 summary and support artifacts

decision_rule: M2129 passes if it audits M2128 and selects a bounded next route without rerun or ranking.
